item.title: system-one-router: Letting a "System One" Model Pick the Right LLM for Every Prompt
item.description: My first model router let an LLM read a prompt file and pick an agent. This one asks a “System One” decision model four typed questions, scores the models with plain arithmetic, and publishes a benchmark to prove it works (and to show where it doesn’t).
